subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “But after a week, many students found that starting was the hardest part.”?
options: Students on early duty often saw him.
The music teacher said this happens often.
Once they began, they often continued longer.
After the poster was placed near the office, students began turning off lights more often.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Students on early duty often saw him.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The music teacher said this happens often.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「But after a week, many students found that starting was the hardest part. Once they began, they often continued longer.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「After the poster was placed near the office, students began turning off lights more often.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「But after a week, many students found that starting was the hardest part. Once they began, they often continued longer.」，答案為「Once they began, they often continued longer.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Once they began, they often continued longer.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
